claims.statement: Project Marinus is ramping up construction after financial close and approvals; Stage 1 is a future 750 MW two-way interconnector.
Marinus Link crossed further from financed network option into physical construction without creating operating capacity today.
September LNG shipments through Hormuz reached 19 according to S&P Global and 21 according to Kpler, versus 15 in June, while dark transits persisted.
Higher LNG throughput indicates adaptation to the Hormuz constraint rather than restoration of the pre-war navigation regime.
G7 leaders committed to a coordinated 100 million barrel release through the IEA over four months, beginning immediately, with a substantial diesel release frontloaded within 20 days.
Strategic stocks have become an active policy buffer for the refined-products bottleneck as primary Gulf flows recover faster than product supply.
Gas Malaysia targets FID in H2 2027 for a Kedah LNG terminal with capacity up to 6 mtpa.
Kedah would create an alternative LNG import route for northern Malaysia, but remains an option until FID.
